observed_x86_emulator: No KVM; no AVX/AVX2; MatMulNBits packed path unavailable by ORT CPU dispatch predicate. Unpacked path allocates/dequantizes B per call before SGEMM.
arm64: NEON dispatch; int8 compute enabled when runtime detects dot-product instructions, otherwise GetComputeType falls back to FP32. No mandatory GPU, NNAPI or chipset checks in app.
graph_profile: All-fast desktop profile spent 77,386,188 us in MatMulNBits over 465 calls, the dominant operator. ALL optimization already fuses matrix operations and layer normalization.
provider_choice: CPU EP retained. Custom MatMulNBits is CPU-registered; adding NNAPI/XNNPACK does not establish acceleration for these dominant nodes. No unverified EP partitioning was introduced.
prior_kernel_probe: All-fast variant screened first: 151 correct, 2 wrong bins. Mixed first/last-block FP32 compute selected after 153 correct and 2 wrong bins. Packed int4 weight bytes are identical.
